tasks.partName: Đọc to đoạn văn (Read a Text Aloud)
tasks.prompt: Read the text aloud. You will be evaluated on pronunciation, intonation, and rhythm.
tasks.textToRead: Hawthornes Coffee is now the most popular coffee-house chain in the country. To celebrate this achievement, all Hawthorne’s Coffee locations are offering a special deal for customers. During the month of June, when you buy any Hawthorne's Coffee beverage, you'll receive a second one at half price. That's right: buy any beverage and get half off the second one! This great deal is available at every Hawthorne's Coffee location. Visit one in your area today!

tasks.partName: Miêu tả bức tranh (Describe a Picture)
tasks.prompt: Describe the picture on your screen in as much detail as possible.

photos.imageDescription: Miêu tả bức tranh chi tiết về bối cảnh, con người, hành động và các chi tiết phụ.
photos.sampleBand8Answer: In this photograph, we observe an active and well-illuminated setting. In the foreground, people are focused on their individual tasks while interacting productively. In the middle ground, essential tools and work materials are neatly arranged across the table. In the background, the architectural background and natural lighting establish a modern and organized atmosphere. Overall, the entire scene conveys a strong sense of teamwork and efficiency.

questions.question: If you could take a vacation next week, where would you go?
questions.modelAnswer: If I could take a vacation next week, I would travel to a peaceful coastal town to relax by the ocean and enjoy fresh seafood.

questions.question: How long do you usually spend on vacation, and who do you go with?
questions.modelAnswer: I usually spend about five to seven days on vacation, and I almost always travel with my close family members or best friends.

questions.question: When you go on vacation, do you plan your time thoroughly or do you go without many plans? Describe your style of traveling.
questions.modelAnswer: When I travel, I prefer planning the main accommodations and transport in advance, while keeping daily schedules flexible so I can freely explore hidden local cafes and cultural sights.

tasks.scheduleHtml:
Responds to questions using the information provided

Good morning. I’m Sandra Monaco from the personnel department, and I didn’t get a copy of the Employee Awards Ceremony schedule. Can you tell me about it?

Question 8: Where is the event being held and what time should I get there?

Question 9: As far as I know, the CEO is supposed to be the first speaker, isn’t he?

Question 10: I heard that two different types of employee awards are going to be presented. Could you tell me about the specific awards.

questions.modelAnswer: According to the provided schedule, the event is scheduled to start promptly at 9:00 A.M. in the main auditorium.
Actually, that information is not correct. The session has been rescheduled to the morning, and all participants are invited to attend.
Certainly. There are two sessions scheduled in the afternoon: first, a workshop from 1:30 to 2:45 P.M., followed by a closing discussion at 3:00 P.M.

tasks.partName: Trình bày quan điểm (Express an Opinion)
tasks.prompt: Many people feel that taking time to relax is the key to being productive at work and at home. How do you feel about taking time to relax? Does it make people more productive? Use reasons and examples to support your opinion.
tasks.sampleBand8Answer: I firmly support this stance for two key reasons. First, this approach grants individuals significant flexibility and helps reduce daily cognitive fatigue. Second, having such balanced conditions promotes sustained motivation and superior long-term performance. Therefore, I believe this is unquestionably the most effective choice.
